BiblicalUsage: Gad means fortune, and Leah used the word when she named her son. A troop cometh, she said in Genesis 30:11, and she called his name Gad. The King James renders it as a troop, but the word carries the sense of good fortune — a troop of blessing arriving at once.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Leah's naming of Gad shows how mothers read God's hand in their children; she saw a troop coming and called it fortune, and I hold that every child is a troop of blessing from God.
